messages:
Samir: FYI — I'm proposing a breaking rename in the TS + Python SDKs for routing policies. Current enum values `STRICT` / `FALLBACK` -> new names `PREFER_LOCAL` / `ALLOW_FALLBACK`. This affects client routing, quota matching, and telemetry.
Priya: Can we avoid a hard break? maybe alias the old values for a few releases and emit deprecation warnings? :thinking_face:
Alex: Agreed — we can ship aliases in the SDK for two releases. map old->new internally and log a deprecation warning when old names are used. Server-side should accept both during the window.
Javier: Telemetry concern: dashboards currently aggregate by label `routing_policy=STRICT|FALLBACK`. If we suddenly get `PREFER_LOCAL` we'll split metrics. Need migration/compat plan so dashboards don't double-count.
Rachel: Console UX: show a banner in Routing Policy dropdown that names are changing, link to a migration doc. Also add an audit log event when workspace toggles policy. :loudspeaker:
Samir: Proposed rollout plan:
- SDK change: accept both names, warn when old name used.
- Console: show notice + flag for "compat mode".
- Server: normalize to canonical enum before quota matching/telemetry.
- Timeline: canary SDK -> 2 weeks -> remove aliases after 2 more weeks.
Priya: Quotas question: does quota matching use the raw string from client? If so, normalizing server-side is critical or old quota rules could fail.
Alex: Yes — quota engine currently matches policy by string. I'll open a small PR to normalize input before matching (normalize both client and console inputs to canonical enum).
Javier: For telemetry, propose tagging events with both client-submitted value and canonical value during transition: `routing.policy.client` + `routing.policy.canonical`. That lets us rewrite dashboards and backfill without losing granularity.
Samir: Nice. Also let's add an SDK opt-in flag `emit_canonical_only` so early adopters can start emitting only canonical labels.
Rachel: For rollout UX: add a per-workspace toggle (Console) "SDK compat mode" so teams can opt out of aliases earlier. We'll wire that toggle into the SDK release notes so customers know how to opt-in.
Alex: Testing plan: unit tests for enum aliasing, cross-language smoke tests (py/ts), and a migration integration test that runs a sample quota rule against both old and new names. I'll coordinate with eng-sre for the canary.
Samir: I'll draft deprecation changelog + migration guide. @Priya can you own the SDK release notes and the quick migration script for infra configs?
Priya: Yep — will include a `sed` snippet and a small JS/Python script to rewrite config files. Also will add explicit examples for customers using programmatic quota rules.
Alex: Quick code snippet for the aliasing idea:
```ts
// before
export enum RoutingPolicy { STRICT = 'STRICT', FALLBACK = 'FALLBACK' }

// new (internal mapping)
export enum RoutingPolicy { PREFER_LOCAL = 'PREFER_LOCAL', ALLOW_FALLBACK = 'ALLOW_FALLBACK' }

// alias map
const _alias = { STRICT: 'PREFER_LOCAL', FALLBACK: 'ALLOW_FALLBACK' }
function normalize(policy: string) { return _alias[policy] || policy }
```
Samir: Add note: SDK should emit a single deprecation log line per process startup (not per request) to avoid log spam.
Javier: On the telemetry side I'll add a script to reconcile historical `STRICT` -> `PREFER_LOCAL` so dashboards can switch to canonical metric names with a backfill.
Rachel: Console change: when we flip the dropdown to show new names, include hover text mapping old->new for a month. Also surface a KPI that shows percent of API calls using old names to help monitor rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: devex-489 -> 10% -> 2h -> 50% -> 24h -> 100%
Samir: Thanks. Follow-ups: Alex will open server PR for normalization, Javier will update telemetry + backfill plan, Rachel will spec the console banner & toggle, Priya will draft SDK notes & migration script. I'll put a short RFC in the repo tonight.
Alex: One more follow-up: add an e2e test in console that submits a policy via the UI and ensures the SDK and quota engine see the same canonical enum.
Priya: I'll add that to the release checklist.
Samir: Great — let's sync in next standup if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
